purpose: Build exactly one dense NQ 1-second canonical market-clock data set from immutable raw v0 source Parquets, preserving authoritative native rows even when generic calendar windows disagree.

authorized_source.immutability_check: SHA256 of every source file must match before and after build

calendar.name: CME_Equity
calendar.endpoint_convention: The exact terminal session-close boundary second is valid and included (normal 16:00 CT and calendar-provided early closes); the relevant closure begins after that boundary. In regime 1, exact 15:15:00 CT is valid and the halt begins after that boundary.
calendar.closure_native_exception_policy: Calendar windows guide synthetic fill generation only. Every native row outside a generic calendar window is preserved exactly as a native-only singleton observation and recorded as CALENDAR_CONFLICT_NATIVE_PRESENT; calendar disagreement never blocks publication. Synthetic rows are still omitted from the declared maintenance, halt, weekend, and holiday closures unless an authoritative native row is present.

dense_row_contract.native_row: Copy every native source value exactly and set is_fill=false.
dense_row_contract.missing_expected_second: Set OHLC to the previous canonical close, volume=0, is_fill=true; carry prior non-price metadata causally; never use a future price.
dense_row_contract.scheduled_closure: Emit zero rows. At a reopen, a missing first second may carry the last canonical close from before the closure.
dense_row_contract.timestamp: Preserve native UTC open-stamped ts_event semantics. No ts_init exists in the frozen source schema.
dense_row_contract.ytd_limit: Do not emit a row after the final native 2026/YTD timestamp.

deliverables.format: SINGLE_PARQUET unless a documented writer/filesystem failure requires partitioned fallback

required_validations: one row per expected tradable second

acceptance.calendar_conflicts: Count and report native/calendar conflicts; they are diagnostic warnings and do not block publication.
